title: Russian Ballistic Missile and Drone Barrage on Kyiv Kills 17
detail: A roughly two-hour barrage of Russian ballistic missiles and long-range drones struck Kyiv and its surrounding region overnight August 4-5, killing at least 17 civilians and wounding 44, per the UN human rights office in Ukraine. The overnight assault hit the Brovarskyi district railway platform and damaged homes, schools, transport infrastructure, water systems, and humanitarian warehouses. Zelensky said Ukraine has been receiving three times fewer anti-ballistic interceptors since the start of 2026, largely due to the war in the Middle East diverting Patriot supplies — all missiles in the barrage followed ballistic trajectories that only Patriot-class systems can intercept.

title: Ukrainian Strike Kills Four in Russia's Kursk Region; North Korean Missile Unit Deploys to Voronezh
detail: Ukraine struck an industrial facility in Russia's Kursk region on August 5, killing four and injuring one, according to Russian regional governor Alexander Khinshtein — hours after Russia's deadly ballistic missile barrage on Kyiv. Separately, Ukrainian military intelligence reported a North Korean missile unit of roughly 90 personnel had begun deploying to Russia's Voronezh region (within the 112th Missile Brigade, ~150km from the Ukrainian border), with 40 KN-23/KN-24 short-range ballistic missiles already delivered and plans for up to 120 missiles and six launchers.
